Team —

Quick request for an offer exception for Olivia Turner (candidate, ex-Azure/Inferencing team). Summary: strong infra + LLM engineering background, passed loop, hiring manager recommends. We have a live competing offer (verbal) from a FAANG at $225k base + 0.5% equity and a $40k sign-on.

Our draft baseline offer (band 5): base $185,000, target OTE/market comp ~ $200k, 0.25% equity, standard 20k sign-on. Candidate has asked for closer parity.

Requesting approval to make a one-time exception:
- Increase sign-on to $25,000 (one-time, payable 30 days after start)
- Equity refresh/entry grant to 0.30% (4-year vesting, standard cliffs)
- Maintain base offer at $190,000 (slightly above band midpoint)

Rationale:
- Candidate brings direct product+inference experience that reduces ramp and will unblock two high-impact initiatives (prefetch KV cache work and seq-length optimizations).
- Comp is still below the competing verbal offer, but the sign-on + slightly larger equity should make us competitive without moving the comp band structurally.
- Hiring is mission-critical to Q1 delivery; we have an open approved headcount in team 14 (already reserved).

Attachments: resume, offer_draft_v1.pdf, comp_justification_olivia.docx.

Asks:
1) Laura: HR/comp sign-off on exception (sign-on + equity bump) and confirmation on approval authority needed for equity above 0.25%.
2) Vivek: budget confirmation / revenue-side note (do you want us to route to finance?)
3) Karthik: final business sign-off if you’re comfortable with the terms; if approved, I’ll ask OfferOps to finalize and send to Olivia with a 72-hour window to accept.

Thanks — Vanessa
